name: DreamBox Learning
tagline: DreamBox Learning is an intelligent adaptive learning platform for elementary and middle school maths that uses game mechanics to keep students engaged. Its AI makes over 48,000 micro-adjustments per hour per student, adapting the learning path in real time. Research shows students using DreamBox outperform peers on standardised tests.
